regime_context: The detector shows a broad, health-care-centric leadership: Big Pharma is the headline (eligible, trend, full breadth, but crowded with crowding_z=1.5), with Health Care EW and other defensives/staple themes tightly clustered behind. Momentum rank is a focus lens only (rank-IC ~0), but the absolute-trend gate is validated on this market's history (gate_helps=true), so trend eligibility is the discipline's core leg. Rotation radar is display-only.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Health Care (Equal-Weight) sustains eligibility AND breadth above 0.85 for another 10 sessions while Big Pharma's PPH holds above its 20-day average; a failure of PPH to hold while XLV decouples would suggest the leadership is thinning and would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline theme and is eligible with an 0.84 durability bar and full breadth (1.0). The trend gate is the one validated edge in this market, and it clears here. This is a trend-continuation lean, not a momentum-rank buy.
theses.dissent: crowding_z=1.5 and crowded=true means the theme is extended and reflexively fragile; attention spike may mark a local top.

falsifier.text: PPH prints a fresh 20-day low before 2026-12-03.

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: A second eligible, trend-confirmed health-care sleeve with high durability (0.78) and strong breadth (0.883). The absolute-trend gate is the support; the lead is coherent with Big Pharma, suggesting a health-care leadership structure rather than a single-name anomaly.
theses.dissent: crowded=true and crowding_z=1.55 mean it is mid-crowd; if the health-care narrative unwinds, both this and Big Pharma de-rate together.

falsifier.text: XLV breaks its 50-day average and gives up all of the last 10 days of gains.

theses.subject: Defensives
theses.thesis: Trend-eligible (durability 0.83), broad (0.944) and consistent with the defensive/health-care leadership structure. The trend gate is the key leg. Marked as scorable=false (proxy is a basket, XLP/XLU), so this lean is lower-confidence by construction.
theses.dissent: No single scorable proxy; the theme is crowded (z=1.57), and defensive leadership can reverse quickly when the macro risk mood flips.

falsifier.text: XLP lags SPY by 3% before the check-by date.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
